sentences.en: She has a tattoo of a lizard on her thigh.
sentences.zh: 她在大腿上纹了一条蜥蜴。

sentences.en: All I want for Christmas is a new tattoo.
sentences.zh: 我圣诞节想要的礼物就是做一个新的纹身。

sentences.en: The quadruplets are only distinguishable by little jailhouse tattoos behind their ears.
sentences.zh: 这四胞胎只能通过他们耳朵后面的小监狱纹身来区分。
